purpose: Define the complete current environmental measurement universe for the EAzami exploratory atlas independently of Azami outcome selection. The universe matches Chapter 1 only to make later cross-chapter comparison commensurate.

existing_occurrence_asset.construction: GBIF source scientificName guard -> Japan bounds/geospatial issue filter -> strict <=10 km coordinate uncertainty where >=10 records otherwise documented fallback -> 0.1 degree taxon-specific thinning -> complete BIO1/BIO4/BIO12/BIO15 extraction
existing_occurrence_asset.reuse_boundary: The old run failed only in a late empty-slot audit after the occurrence and environment files were written. Reuse requires rechecking query/source-name agreement and nonmissing coordinates; sampling-candidate rankings are not used for species environmental centroids.

selection_rule: All nine predictors are retained regardless of Azami or EAzami effect size, P value, direction or biological narrative.
environment_centroid_rule: For every focal taxon, use the median across the same source-name-guarded, spatially thinned occurrence cohort after all nine environmental values are available. Do not use the 25-per-taxon niche-sampling candidate table because it intentionally enriches environmental/geographic edges.
claim_boundary: The common nine-variable universe is a measurement alignment with Azami, not an Azami-derived hypothesis set.
The nine predictors are correlated observational gradients.
GSP is a climatic growing-season construct, not taxon-specific flowering-season precipitation.
NPP is modelled potential productivity, not measured resource supply.
Current environmental medians do not identify historical exposure, selection or adaptation.
